resolution_of_prior_blocker.resolution: export.validate_b_fold_manifest now dispatches on the manifest's own fold_manifest_format_version field: the production format routes to production_fold_contract_v0_1.validate_production_fold_document (verifies the exact signed mapping directly, never attempts to regenerate it); the historical (absent-field) format is untouched.
resolution_of_prior_blocker.root_cause: The real production fold manifest inherits its fold assignment from an original, pre-join, six-layout greedy computation (row counts 507/502/335/524/418/170) it never rebalances after only five of those six layouts were admitted with reduced, post-join per-frame counts (409/387/335/292/272). D's historical mineocclude.probes.splits.validate_fold_manifest recomputes a fresh assignment from the reduced counts alone, which is structurally incapable of reproducing an inherited, pre-join assignment.
